observation.happening: A three-pane meeting-notes view: nav sidebar, main summary/transcript with cited claims ([1][2][3]), and a right panel showing the sourced quote behind citation [1].
observation.most_important: The client's main concern (initial cost) is summarized and directly traceable to the transcript line highlighted in gray.
observation.next_action: Click another citation number or transcript line to inspect its source, or switch tabs (録音/関連ファイル/出所).
anomalies: Right-hand source panel is mostly empty white space below a single short quote, unbalanced against the dense left/middle panes

808D.why: Citation-linked summary-to-transcript is executed with real polish and restraint, but the right panel's near-empty vertical space is a concrete imbalance next to a genre (Granola-style meeting notes) whose best-in-class execs keep every pane purposefully filled.

observation.happening: Live recording is running but speech-to-text is blocked by a missing OS permission; the app surfaces a clear amber warning banner with a direct fix action.
observation.most_important: Recording continues safely, but transcription is stalled until the user grants permission via '設定を開く'.
observation.next_action: Click 設定を開く to grant permission, or keep recording without live transcript.
anomalies: Three separate empty states stacked at once (empty transcript, 'まだありません' for decisions/todos, empty 'AIが見ている資料') while nothing else is happening on screen

8688.why: The permission error itself is communicated unusually well (specific cause + direct fix link, not a generic apology), but stacking three simultaneous empty sections makes the whole screen read as broken/half-populated rather than a single well-handled error state.

observation.happening: Same live-meeting app now working normally: transcript is populating with speaker turns, and a right panel surfaces related resources (file/Gmail/Drive) ranked by relevance bars.
observation.most_important: The most recent utterance ('OAuthだけ確認お願いします。') is mirrored in the sidebar and matched to a relevant resource with a relevance-bar indicator.
observation.next_action: Ask a question in 'この会議について聞く', or open one of the surfaced resources on the right.
anomalies: The blue relevance bars have no scale, label, or legend, so their meaning (length = relevance?) must be inferred

89A8.why: Live transcript-to-resource matching is a genuinely useful, well laid out feature, but the unlabeled relevance bars are a small unexplained affordance a top-tier product would annotate or make interactive.
